schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Patch bumps grouped per workspace package (apps/start, apps/backend, packages/ui, etc.) rather than either extreme: one PR per dependency (too much noise across ~20 package.json files) or one PR for the whole monorepo (unreviewable, and one bad bump blocks every other update behind it).
Minor bumps get their own group per workspace package, separate from patch — kept apart so a single PR's release label is never ambiguous between the two.

Majors are never grouped — each carries real breaking-change risk and deserves its own review. This mirrors today's behavior, just with a correct release label instead of the previous config's blanket release:patch on every update type regardless of size.
